scope: Source inspection only. Live deployment revision, browser computed styles, desktop/WASM pixels, accessibility, motion and performance are not verified. Component conformance remains unreviewed.

required_cases.cases: Elevated, filled, outlined in light/dark; fixed outer size; no padding and site-example 16px padding; long text; changed root font size.
Equal filled/outlined content rects and wrapping; outline painted inside rounded bounds without consuming layout.
Parent text color deliberately differs from on-surface; caller override; edge-to-edge image and overflowing child are clipped.
Button/link primary action, padding/body/title activation, Space/Enter/Tab; secondary button/link does not trigger primary.
Rest, hover, focus-visible, pressed, dragged, disabled and combinations; disabled transitions; noninteractive card remains static.
Incoming/outgoing start, midpoint, endpoint; hover-to-press, leave during transition and reversal; normal/reduced-motion.
Variant changes, primary action mount/unmount, disabled toggle, role/name, focus ring and forced colors.

source_findings: Actual CSS keeps outlined hover/focus/pressed at its rest elevation, despite generated hover tokens; implementation must follow resolved component CSS.
Primary card explicitly sets on-surface text and clips overflow; the current adapter relies on inherited text color and does not clip.
Primary outlined border is an inset pseudo-element overlay; current border_1 consumes layout space.
Primary base card does not force padding or full width; site examples add 16px padding, while current convenience helper sets full width and rem-based padding.
Current adapter only provides static variants; interactive primary action, secondary-control isolation, disabled/dragged states and reference elevation transitions are not implemented.
Primary elevated disabled container mixes surface with the same surface endpoint; do not infer a different color from comments or token names.
next_implementation_scope: Verify and correct static surface semantics first; then reuse Kit/Base behavior for interactive primary action without nesting secondary controls inside a button. Source rules tests do not establish raster, motion or performance PASS.
